name: lattice
description: Module-boundary diagnostics in the buffer for Go, Rust, Python and Vue, read from your Nx workspace's own boundary config

lattice.server.path.markdownDescription:
Path to the boundary server's `lsp.mjs`. Relative paths resolve against the Nx workspace root.

Leave this empty unless you are developing the server itself. Empty means the `@ecoma-io/lattice` installed in the workspace — the same version your pipeline runs, and therefore the only one whose verdicts are guaranteed to match it.

A path that does not exist is reported rather than ignored: this extension will not quietly fall back to a different server than the one you named.

lattice.trace.server.description: Log the conversation with the boundary server to the Lattice output channel. The channel's log-level dropdown (Output panel gear icon) is the master switch: set it to Trace, then choose messages or verbose here.
